source_claim: The primary Chinese text 西遊記, catalogued by Project Gutenberg under author Wu Cheng'en and alternate English title Journey to the West, names Tang Sanzang (唐三藏/三藏) and identifies his three disciples as Sun Wukong (孫悟空), Zhu Wuneng / Zhu Bajie (豬悟能/豬八戒), and Sha Wujing (沙悟淨). The same novel directly features Guanyin Bodhisattva (觀音菩薩) throughout its narrative. The five campaign characters therefore have direct HOME in Journey to the West.
notes: The original text can be checked in the public Chinese Project Gutenberg transcription at https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/23962/pg23962.txt. A passage naming the party and their identities occurs in the latter half of the text: 三藏 states his Dharma name is 玄奘 and names disciples 孫悟空, 豬悟能, 沙悟淨; the same passage says their names were given by 南海觀世音菩薩. Gutenberg's book record https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/23962 identifies the Chinese title 西遊記, author Wu Cheng'en, and alternate title Journey to the West. No adaptation-specific variants or alternate HOME edges are added.
